skill.name: decision-moment-skill
skill.description: Map and optimize decision moments across Awareness, Consideration, Conversion, and Retention, then attach specific assets, visuals, and automations to each stage. Use when designing funnels, campaigns, or retention systems.
skill.summary: Create structured decision-moment maps for funnels, campaigns, onboarding, and retention systems.
skill.author: CleanExpo

content.value_statement: Campaign teams often miss the exact question that blocks a buyer from moving forward. This skill turns each funnel stage into clear moments, proof needs, assets, channels, and retention actions.
actual_capabilities: Maps buyer journey stages from awareness through retention.
Defines decision moments with objections, proof needs, and asset types.
Connects moments to channels such as email, ads, social posts, and landing pages.
Suggests database tables for storing decision maps and asset links.
Supports campaign, onboarding, conversion, and retention planning.
limitations: Does not verify external marketing claims or performance data.
Does not create finished creative assets by itself.
Requires accurate offer, audience, and funnel context from the user.
Does not include analytics instrumentation or attribution logic.

use_cases.title: Plan a Launch Funnel
use_cases.description: Convert a new offer into staged buyer questions, required proof, and asset recommendations.

use_cases.title: Improve Onboarding
use_cases.description: Map early customer doubts to tutorials, check-ins, and support assets that improve activation.

use_cases.title: Audit Conversion Gaps
use_cases.description: Identify missing proof, weak objections handling, and unclear asset routing in an existing flow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the decision-moment skill to map this offer across awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention: [offer details].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a single offer

prompt_templates.title: Find Missing Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this funnel and list the decision moments that lack proof, objection handling, or a matching asset: [funnel details].

prompt_templates.title: Design Channel Routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an execution map that connects each decision moment to email, ads, social posts, landing pages, and retention touchpoints: [campaign context].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Retention Moments
prompt_templates.prompt: Map the post-purchase decision moments for these customers and recommend onboarding, education, upsell, and check-in assets: [customer context].

output_examples.input: A coaching program needs a funnel for service business owners.
output_examples.output: A journey map that names each decision stage, the buyer concern, the proof needed, and the recommended asset type.

output_examples.input: An onboarding flow has low activation after signup.
output_examples.output: A retention map with early doubts, tutorial ideas, check-in timing, and customer success assets for each moment.

output_examples.input: A product page converts poorly despite strong traffic.
output_examples.output: A conversion review that lists blocking objections, missing evidence, and suggested demos, testimonials, or pricing content.

best_practices: Provide the offer, audience, current assets, and main conversion goal before using the skill.
Tie every recommended asset to a specific buyer question or objection.
Review claims against verified value propositions before publishing campaign content.
anti_patterns: Using the framework without clear audience or offer details.
Treating every stage as a sales pitch instead of answering the buyer's next question.
Adding assets that are not connected to a decision moment or channel.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a decision-moment map with journey stages, objections, proof needs, asset types, and channel routing.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it create marketing copy?
faq.answer: It can guide asset planning, but it does not define a full copywriting workflow.

faq.question: Can it help with retention?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes retention moments such as onboarding, tutorials, upsells, and check-ins.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the offer, target customer, current funnel, known objections, existing assets, and conversion goal.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructions only describe planning outputs and do not require network services.
